title: Nutty Bouncy Southern Thai Chicken Skewers
description: A winey and adventurous Southern Thai dish featuring diced tomatoes and a soffritto base, served on a hot stone plate. This high protein friendly dish is perfect for those looking for a flavorful and healthy meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, peanut oil, Thai red curry paste, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the bowl and stir to combine.
Add the chicken breast pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a hot stone plate and bake in the oven for 15 minutes.
While the chicken is cooking, heat a small saucepan over medium heat and add the chopped peanuts.
Cook the peanuts, stirring frequently, until they are lightly toasted and fragrant.
Remove the chicken from the oven and top each skewer with a spoonful of diced tomatoes and a sprinkle of toasted peanuts.
Return the skewers to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
